reviews.title: Fikwot solid state drive.
reviews.comment: Nice drive. Quick. Quiet. Worked well in budget laptops. Purchased two. For two laptops ten years old. Put life back into them. So far very pleased. Easy to work with. Fit and fish was very nice. Packaging was easy to open. Instructions not so easy to read. Luckily common sense takes over , you won't need them. Compatibility, if the sata cable fit and the computer red it your golden. Transfer was really quick. It was a 500 gb. It what I worked with, it came with other sizes in storage capacity. I purchased the 2.5" perfect fit for my laptop. Speed was good onto the solid state drive. Overall I am like the Fikwot drive.
reviews.author: Quentin spaur

reviews.title: Two Terabytes, easy install
reviews.comment: One of my previous purchases on Amazon, was an ASUS NUC14Pro "desktop". Shipping with 1 TB SSD M2 2280 installed with Win11Pro, I wanted to quickly add a 2TB SSD. There were two slots for more storage, one SATA and another for SSD M2 2242. Admittedly, I took the less expensive route and bought this SATA SSD on sale. It arrived, I opened the computer's tool free case and slid the drive in the appropriate spot and secured it with the provided screws. It was terribly uneventful. It works, performance is great. I had never heard of the drive's manufacturer, but the build quality was beyond reproach. It works as described, was a good price and works and works and works so well you forget you installed it. Just like storage should behave. Reccommended highly!
reviews.author: Grantig Zwerg

reviews.title: Compatible with a raspberry pi streaming server.
reviews.comment: I turned this into an external SSD for my Raspberry Pi streaming server. It's been a dependable drive. Fast loading of my movies. With 2 terabytes of storage, you can put over 800 movies and shows on it.
reviews.author: Joshua L. Ankney

reviews.title: SSD as an External Hard Drive for Storage
reviews.comment: Will work as a SSD External Storage Drive. Just need to purchase a cable to fit the drive with a usb a end. When you plug it in you will probably need to go into drive settings and enable the drive to make it work, at least in Windows 11. It works fine for my external drive file saving purposes.
reviews.author: Bruce Poore
